features.title: Liquid Glass panel
features.summary: A real system glass panel, not a blur imitation, with a selection lens that glides between rows.

features.title: Fuzzy search
features.summary: An in-house matcher that understands prefixes, acronyms, camelCase, word order and typos.

features.title: Learns your habits
features.summary: Pick a result twice for a query and it becomes the top hit. Everything it learns stays on your Mac.

features.title: Suggestions before you type
features.summary: Ranks what you are likely to open next from the time of day, the app in front and what you just used.

features.title: Apps and System Settings
features.summary: Open, quit, hide or reveal any app, and jump straight to a System Settings pane.

features.title: Hotkeys, aliases and favorites
features.summary: Give any item a global hotkey or a short alias, and pin favorites to the top.

features.title: Themes
features.summary: Seven built-in themes, among them Spotlight, with the query in a capsule above the results, and Glass, the system's clear glass with no tint. Change tint, clarity, lens style, accent, text size and row height. The preview shows each change, and the launcher uses it at once. Save a copy under a new name, and share any theme as a file. Keep the launcher light or dark, or let it follow the system.

features.title: Action panel
features.summary: Every result has more actions behind Command-K, with their own shortcuts.

features.title: Updates
features.summary: Once you agree, checks GitHub once a day for a new version and offers it. Sparkle installs an update only when you choose to, after checking its signature. A build from source updates with git instead.

features.title: File search
features.summary: Slick keeps its own index of file names, which answers in milliseconds, and lets you browse folders.

features.title: Calculator
features.summary: Math, percentages, units, dates and time zones, answered as you type and copied with Return. Currency conversions fetch rates the first time you ask for one.

features.title: Clipboard history
features.summary: Search text, links, images and files you copied, and paste them back.

features.title: Snippets
features.summary: Saved text with placeholders that you find and paste from the launcher.

features.title: Window management
features.summary: Halves, thirds, quarters, centering and moving windows between displays.

features.title: System commands
features.summary: Sleep, lock, restart or shut down the Mac, empty the Trash, eject disks, toggle dark mode, set the volume and quit processes.

features.title: Quicklinks and web search
features.summary: Open sites and searches with a keyword, and fall back to the web when nothing local matches.

features.title: Emoji picker
features.summary: Search emoji and symbols by name and paste them.

features.title: Script commands
features.summary: Run your own scripts from the launcher, with arguments and live output.

features.title: Universal actions
features.summary: Act on the text or files selected in any app.

features.title: Dictionary
features.summary: Look up a word with define, check its spelling, and copy or paste the definition.

features.title: Calendar and reminders
features.summary: Your day's events, a meeting to join when it is about to start, and new events and reminders from the launcher.

features.title: Contacts
features.summary: Find a person and call, message, email or FaceTime them.

features.title: Browser bookmarks
features.summary: Search the bookmarks of Safari, Chrome, Firefox and other browsers and open them.

features.title: Menu items
features.summary: Search and run any menu command of the app in front.

features.title: AI, with your own key
features.summary: Ask questions with Apple's on-device model or a provider you configure. Nothing is sent unless you ask.

features.title: Shell commands
features.summary: Type > and a command to run it in your login shell and see its output, with a history of past commands.

features.title: Notes
features.summary: Quick notes kept as Markdown files that any editor opens. Save one from root search, search titles and text, append, pin, tag, rename and paste them.

features.title: Color picker
features.summary: Pick a color on screen, keep the colors you use, and convert hex, RGB, HSL, HWB and OKLCH as you type, with WCAG contrast.

features.title: Translate
features.summary: Translate typed or selected text with the languages installed on the Mac, on a page or with tr in root search. Translate sends nothing over the network itself.

features.title: Media controls
features.summary: Play, pause and skip tracks in Music and Spotify, and see what is playing.
